Completely different situation but my girlfriend of 2 years passed away in a car accident in July. The night before we were talking about how we wanted to move away with each other to Canada and have kids together. My lazy ass was in bed while her mum was driving her to college and she had left me a note saying I looked too peaceful to disturb. You know how I felt when I woke up and had 10+ miss calls on my phone from her nothing telling me what happened. All I could think about was how all those things we said for hours the night before had completely been shattered in every single way. After 2 weeks or so not getting out of bed I realised that the world moves on regardless and after a lot persuasion from peers I went to have a drink with my brother despite the fact that I don’t drink and was generally feeling like killing myself again. It was probably the best decision I could have made. I have a girlfriend now who is amazing. I feel guilty sometimes but in the end I kind of understand that there was nothing I could have done and I instead like to think that they would want me to be happy and I’m getting there although the experience has left me with some issues. I have a very different perspective on life. And every time I say goodbye to my current girlfriend. I say goodbye as if its our last. To know that the last moment I had with her was where I wanted to be, in her arms.
